Title: Senior Embedded Developer
Company: Example AB
Location: Gothenburg

Full job description
We are looking for a Senior Embedded Developer to join a safety-critical automotive team.

Requirements:
- Strong C++ and C programming skills
- Experience with AUTOSAR, Vector DaVinci, Git, and Jenkins
- CI/CD, verification and validation, SIL/HIL, and test automation
- Embedded software development for real-time systems

Nice to have:
- Python, MATLAB, and Simulink
- Experience working with cross-functional teams in Gothenburg
